name: Red Hat Sales Plays
description: Comprehensive instantiation of the Sales Play Framework covering all five Red Hat Sales Plays (AI-Ready Enterprise, Build and Run Applications, IT Operations Efficiency, Modernize Infrastructure, Digital Sovereignty) and six Technology Decision Points (Server/Cloud OS, Virtualization, Container Management, Application Platform, Automation, AI Platform) with embedded sales tactics. Each Sales Play practice positions Red Hat for specific market themes through customer lenses, persona engagement, and multi-TDP orchestration. Each TDP practice provides deep technology positioning with domain-specific sales tactics for customer challenge conversations.

narratives.name: Red Hat Sales Plays Method Journey
narratives.description: The Red Hat Sales Plays method orchestrates five strategic Sales Plays and six Technology Decision Points into a comprehensive go-to-market system that enables sellers to position Red Hat's portfolio through structured customer engagement, multi-TDP solution selling, and competitive differentiation.

narrativeContexts.context: A seller identifies a customer's strategic priorities and selects the relevant Sales Play, applying the customer lens to map pain points to Red Hat capabilities and engaging target personas through structured discovery conversations.

Through TDP-level technical positioning and tactic-level challenge conversations, the seller validates solution fit using competitive battle cards, technology credentials, and customer reference evidence across the relevant technology domains.

The seller articulates a multi-TDP solution narrative connecting Cost, Complexity, and Choice value drivers into a coherent business case that addresses the customer's technology decisions across infrastructure, platform, and automation layers.

Value-based positioning from the play's customer lens and competitive differentiation from TDP battle cards guide negotiation strategy, supported by customer success stories and analyst validation from the method's citation library.

Play execution metrics and TDP win rates validate the engagement outcome, with structured handoff from sales to customer success ensuring continuity of the value narrative established during the play lifecycle.

Multi-play account orchestration identifies expansion opportunities by mapping the customer's evolving strategic initiatives to additional Sales Plays and TDPs, creating a portfolio-level growth narrative driven by demonstrated platform value.
